objective: Add a target measurement procedure that samples the module under the real workload and writes one checksummed artifact, a budget derived from documented figures with every row marked ESTIMATE, and the command plus required fields BSP-PERF-001 was missing.
decision_supported: Does a measurement of the target module exist as a procedure and a budget, and does a host without the module refuse by name instead of writing an empty report?
acceptance: A target measurement script records the power mode, the clock state, per-core and GPU utilization, memory, the module temperature and the throttling counters, at a fixed interval, into a checksummed artifact with the SoC and JetPack version.
The default workload is the offline demo plus the container image the release ships, so the number is about this software rather than a synthetic loop.
A committed budget states the memory ceiling for the combinations that run together, derived from documented figures, with every number marked ESTIMATE until a capture exists.
BSP-PERF-001 gains the exact command and the required fields in bringup-plan.yaml, and its result stays NOT_EXECUTED.
A missing nvpmodel, a missing thermal zone or a missing workload is a named refusal that writes no artifact, not an empty report.
The artifact carries a sha256 sidecar, and a rewritten file fails its digest.
evidence: measure_target_power.py --check on this host: exit 2 with REFUSED: NVPMODEL_UNAVAILABLE, which is the real path here because the host has no NVIDIA module.

pytest tests/unit/test_target_measurement.py: 24 passed, covering the three named refusals, the refusal writing no artifact, the artifact digest, a rewritten artifact failing its digest, and every budget row being ESTIMATE.
validate_manifests.py: PASS with the BSP-PERF-001 command and fields.
A full make test comparison against the unmodified main baseline showing the same pre-existing environment-blocked failures and no new ones.
stop_conditions: A capture from a real module would have to exist to claim a measured budget; none does, so every row stays ESTIMATE and BSP-PERF-001 stays NOT_EXECUTED.
The power mode would have to be chosen; it is a product decision and the artifact records whichever mode applied.
A write outside allowed_paths is required, especially to the hardware release tree or the rootfs.
A refusal would have to be turned into a zero value to make the script succeed on a host without the module.
data_classification: Repository-local Python, JSON and YAML. The script reads /proc and sysfs; it writes no personal data and no credentials.
model_policy: Deterministic Python and pytest; no model inference and no network access added by this change.
risks_and_fallbacks: The budget numbers are estimates. Every row is marked ESTIMATE with a recorded basis, and the file states plainly that no capture exists, so a reader cannot mistake an estimate for a measurement.

The measurement script cannot be exercised end to end here because the module is absent. The refusals are tested, and the sampling path is exercised only for its arithmetic; the pull request says the measurement itself was not taken.
A GPU figure of None is not zero: a host without a GPU has no GPU number, and writing 0.0 would say the GPU was idle rather than absent.
Rollback is a revert of this commit: the script and the budget disappear and BSP-PERF-001 returns to having no procedure. Nothing reads the budget yet.
